extracted.name: Southwest Fiesta Dressing
extracted.description: This is a quick and easy homemade, creamy, Southwest dressing recipe for salads that also works as a dip. Use it at your next taco night or barbecue!
ingredient_lines: 0.5 teaspoon chili powder, or to taste
instruction_lines: Stir yogurt, sour cream, ketchup, onion, lime juice, cilantro, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, and salt together in a bowl with a whisk until smooth.
Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until chilled, at least 10 minutes.
